maintained_sources.equipment_ports: tools/standards/equipment_ports.py feet() derives every equipment foot from fits mount sockets; with_feet() overwrites foot-* on regeneration. A hand-edited foot coordinate is not stable.
maintained_sources.mounts: tools/standards/mounting.py owns generic cradle/deck/socket geometry, stock wrappers and load-port contracts. Existing interface dimensions apply to the named interface, not arbitrary product bores.
maintained_sources.physical_mounts: docs/proposals/physical-mounts.md is the maintained design rationale; current equipment/mount/connector/interface records are exact formal references.
maintained_sources.roof_tank: docs/ships/explorer-roof-cradle-contract.yaml already rejects generic tank-s1/M42 as unchanged500kg tank saddle match.

ships_handoff: Design hull-owned supports only from actual measured product fixed contact surfaces, bores and proper local frame; root empties position the package but do not certify the fastener pattern. Preserve package hashes and do not silently cut caps or rewrite product feet.

Separate generic formal fits/ports from model physical interfaces in the support ledger. Record both and mark each mismatch. Hull support naming does not resolve the existing product metadata inconsistency.

For each observed service bore, preserve its source position/axis/diameter but leave connector standard/half/seal/T/P/flow/current duty unresolved unless the named current interface/connector record actually supplies it. Generated invented service positions do not locate physical bores by themselves.

A future corrected product physical mount contract needs an explicit compatible identity/frame, measured bore and contact pattern, keeper/tool/service envelopes and duty/load assumptions, plus a generator change; no product edits in this audit.

Real compact adapters may be drawn as new hull-owned parts with stock, positive geometry and actual fasteners. No claim to generic mount rating, unchanged catalogue load qualification or installed fit before combined current hull/service/crew/plume check.
scope: GLB node world transforms composed from actual hierarchy/TRS in glTF coordinates. No axis-facing inference, mesh-hole/contact measurement, service-rating verification, support sizing or whole-craft design performed.
